planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; wiring preserved as: D2 button input, D9 LED output (PWM-capable per Uno), A0 analog input used to command the LED intensity/level when enabled.
No explicit wiring for serial I/O, display modules, sensors, or other peripherals is provided.

Assumption: button is wired such that the model boolean should be true when pressed (no additional inversion). Active-high/pullup electrical details were not specified, so pullup/active_high are left to catalog defaults.
If the intent was a non-PWM digital LED (on/off), the LED still uses a PWM output on D9 as requested by the resolved pin role; SysML should map A0 to the desired PWM behavior and thresholding.
